notes.title: Liminal Border Part Ⅳ will be coming to Steam on Steptember 4th!
notes.content:
Liminal Border Part Ⅳ will be coming to Steam on Steptember 4th!Wishlist now ➡
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3591440/Liminal_Border_Part_IV/"][/dynamiclink]
ABOUT THIS GAME
The conclusion of the Liminal Border visual novel series. After the countless twists and turns of Part III, Itsuki's business is now a massive success, but all he can see is the need for revenge. Standing on the border between justice and evil, which way will Itsuki fall??
